verdict.rationale: Pilot is a done-for-you bookkeeping service. A customer reports that Pilot's bank, card, and Expensify integrations 'handle all of the transaction classification' with zero founder effort. Founders can give feedback on outstanding items through the portal, which is a rough path for corrections. Nothing shows founder-facing categorization suggestions or a system that learns from corrections; classification appears to be handled by Pilot's team and integrations. Missing for 10: categorization suggestions shown to the founder, learning from user corrections, any documentation of auto-categorization rules or ML behavior, hands-on corroboration of a suggestion workflow.
